```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)

})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step B. TF-NLR candidate regulatory network
##
## Evidence:
##   1. MEME motif discovered from 181 DE NLR promoters
##   2. Tomtom motif similarity to Arabidopsis DAP motifs
##   3. FIMO motif occurrence in NLR promoters
##   4. TF-NLR expression correlation
##   5. WGCNA module consistency
##
## Main output:
##   04_TF_NLR_network/
##     Candidate_TF_NLR_edges.tsv
##     Candidate_TF_NLR_nodes.tsv
##     Cytoscape_TF_NLR_edges.tsv
##     Cytoscape_TF_NLR_nodes.tsv
##     Candidate_TF_hub_ranking.tsv
##     Candidate_NLR_regulatory_target_ranking.tsv
############################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(scales)
})

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

############################################################
## 0. Settings
############################################################

outdir <- analysis_file("04_TF_NLR_network")
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

fig_outdir <- file.path(outdir, "figures")
dir.create(fig_outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

## Input files
tomtom_html_file <- "meme1.5kb/Tomtom Results.html"
tomtom_tsv_file <- "meme1.5kb/tomtom.tsv"

fimo_nlr_file <- "nlr.1.5kb.fimo.tsv"
fimo_all_file <- "1.5kb.fimo.tsv"

tf_annotation_file <- analysis_file("Pt_TF_annotation.tsv")

nlr_master_file <- analysis_file("NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv")

## Filtering parameters
tomtom_q_cutoff <- 0.10
top_tomtom_hits_per_motif <- 5

fimo_p_cutoff <- 1e-4
fimo_q_cutoff <- 0.10

min_abs_cor <- 0.70
max_cor_pvalue <- 0.05

require_TF_DE <- FALSE
require_same_module <- FALSE

tcr_levels <- c("TNL", "CNL", "RNL")

############################################################
## 1. Helper functions
############################################################

save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 7, height = 5) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(fig_outdir, paste0(filename, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(fig_outdir, paste0(filename, ".png")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

clean_gene_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  id <- stringr::str_extract(x, "Pt[0-9]+G[0-9]+")
  ifelse(is.na(id), str_replace(str_trim(x), "\\.\\d+$", ""), id)
}

as_logical_safe <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  
  x_chr <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    x_chr %in% c("TRUE", "T", "1", "YES", "Y") ~ TRUE,
    x_chr %in% c("FALSE", "F", "0", "NO", "N") ~ FALSE,
    TRUE ~ NA
  )
}

to_num <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
}

normalize_tf_family <- function(x) {
  x0 <- toupper(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  
  case_when(
    str_detect(x0, "AP2|EREBP|ERF|DREB") ~ "AP2/ERF",
    str_detect(x0, "WRKY") ~ "WRKY",
    str_detect(x0, "NAC") ~ "NAC",
    str_detect(x0, "BZIP|TGA|ABI5") ~ "bZIP",
    str_detect(x0, "BHLH|MYC") ~ "bHLH",
    str_detect(x0, "MYB") ~ "MYB",
    str_detect(x0, "TCP") ~ "TCP",
    str_detect(x0, "MADS|AGL|SEP|SOC|VRN") ~ "MADS",
    str_detect(x0, "C2H2|ZAT") ~ "C2H2",
    str_detect(x0, "HD-ZIP|HDZIP|HOMEOBOX|HB") ~ "HD-ZIP",
    str_detect(x0, "C2C2DOF|DOF") ~ "DOF",
    str_detect(x0, "C2C2GATA|GATA") ~ "GATA",
    str_detect(x0, "GRAS") ~ "GRAS",
    str_detect(x0, "B3|ABI3|VP1|ABI3VP1") ~ "B3",
    str_detect(x0, "HSF") ~ "HSF",
    str_detect(x0, "ARF") ~ "ARF",
    str_detect(x0, "AUX|IAA") ~ "AUX/IAA",
    str_detect(x0, "G2LIKE|G2-LIKE") ~ "G2-like",
    str_detect(x0, "BES1") ~ "BES1",
    str_detect(x0, "BBR|BPC") ~ "BPC",
    str_detect(x0, "E2F|DP") ~ "E2F/DP",
    str_detect(x0, "CAMTA") ~ "CAMTA",
    str_detect(x0, "GRF") ~ "GRF",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}

make_motif_alias_long <- function(df, motif_cols, keep_cols = NULL) {
  motif_cols <- intersect(motif_cols, colnames(df))
  keep_cols <- intersect(keep_cols, colnames(df))
  
  if (length(motif_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No motif columns found for alias generation.")
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(row_id_tmp = row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::select(row_id_tmp, all_of(motif_cols), all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(motif_cols),
      names_to = "Motif_source",
      values_to = "Motif"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Motif = as.character(Motif),
      Motif = ifelse(is.na(Motif) | Motif == "" | Motif == "NA", NA_character_, Motif)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Motif)) %>%
    distinct()
}

empty_edge_table <- function() {
  tibble(
    Source = character(),
    Target = character(),
    EdgeType = character(),
    Motif = character(),
    TF_family = character(),
    TF_name = character(),
    NLR_Type = character(),
    Correlation = numeric(),
    abs_cor = numeric(),
    cor_pvalue = numeric(),
    cor_FDR = numeric(),
    Direction = character(),
    EdgeDirection = character(),
    EvidenceScore = numeric(),
    EvidenceClass = character()
  )
}

############################################################
## 2. Read and fix TF annotation
############################################################

if (!file.exists(tf_annotation_file)) {
  stop("Cannot find TF annotation file: ", tf_annotation_file)
}

tf_raw_first <- read_tsv(
  tf_annotation_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
)

if (all(c("Gene", "TF_family") %in% colnames(tf_raw_first))) {
  
  tf_anno <- tf_raw_first %>%
    mutate(
      TF_gene = clean_gene_id(Gene),
      TF_family_raw = if ("TF_family_raw" %in% colnames(.)) as.character(TF_family_raw) else as.character(TF_family),
      TF_family = normalize_tf_family(TF_family),
      TF_name = if ("TF_name" %in% colnames(.)) as.character(TF_name) else TF_gene
    )
  
} else {
  
  message("TF annotation appears to have no standard header. Reading as iTAK-style no-header table.")
  
  tf_raw <- read_tsv(
    tf_annotation_file,
    col_names = FALSE,
    comment = "#",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  if (ncol(tf_raw) < 2) {
    stop("TF annotation file has fewer than 2 columns.")
  }
  
  while (ncol(tf_raw) < 4) {
    tf_raw[[ncol(tf_raw) + 1]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  colnames(tf_raw)[1:4] <- c("Gene", "TF_family_raw", "Category", "Detail")
  
  tf_anno <- tf_raw %>%
    transmute(
      TF_gene = clean_gene_id(Gene),
      TF_family_raw = as.character(TF_family_raw),
      TF_family = normalize_tf_family(TF_family_raw),
      TF_name = TF_gene,
      Category = as.character(Category),
      Detail = as.character(Detail)
    )
}

tf_anno <- tf_anno %>%
  mutate(
    TF_gene = clean_gene_id(TF_gene),
    TF_family_raw = as.character(TF_family_raw),
    TF_family = normalize_tf_family(TF_family),
    TF_name = ifelse(is.na(TF_name) | TF_name == "", TF_gene, as.character(TF_name))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(TF_gene), TF_gene != "",
    !is.na(TF_family), TF_family != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(TF_gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

write_tsv(
  tf_anno,
  file.path(outdir, "TF_annotation_cleaned.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== TF annotation check =====\n")
cat("Total TF genes:", nrow(tf_anno), "\n")
print(
  tf_anno %>%
    count(TF_family, name = "TF_count") %>%
    arrange(desc(TF_count)) %>%
    print(n = 50)
)

############################################################
## 3. Prepare expression matrix as samples x genes
############################################################

if (exists("wgcna_data")) {
  datExpr_raw <- as.data.frame(wgcna_data)
  message("Using wgcna_data as expression matrix.")
} else if (exists("datExpr")) {

} else if (exists("expr_matrix")) {

tf_ids <- tf_anno$TF_gene

overlap_col <- sum(colnames(datExpr_raw) %in% tf_ids)
overlap_row <- sum(rownames(datExpr_raw) %in% tf_ids)

cat("\n===== Expression matrix orientation check =====\n")

if (overlap_row > overlap_col) {

} else {

  message("Expression matrix treated as samples x genes.")

datExpr <- as.data.frame(datExpr)
datExpr[] <- lapply(datExpr, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

gene_sd <- sapply(datExpr, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
keep_cols <- !is.na(gene_sd) & gene_sd > 0
datExpr <- datExpr[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

cat("Final datExpr samples:", nrow(datExpr), "\n")
cat("Final datExpr genes:", ncol(datExpr), "\n")
cat("TF genes in datExpr:", sum(tf_anno$TF_gene %in% colnames(datExpr)), "\n")

############################################################
## 4. Parse Tomtom results
############################################################

extract_json_var_from_html <- function(html_file, varname = "data") {
  
  txt <- paste(readLines(html_file, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
  pattern <- paste0("var\\s+", varname, "\\s*=\\s*\\{")
  m <- regexpr(pattern, txt, perl = TRUE)
  
  if (m[1] < 0) {
    stop("Cannot find JavaScript variable '", varname, "' in ", html_file)
  }
  
  start_match <- as.integer(m[1])
  matched_txt <- regmatches(txt, m)
  open_brace_pos <- start_match + nchar(matched_txt) - 1
  
  subtxt <- substring(txt, open_brace_pos)
  chars <- strsplit(subtxt, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  
  depth <- 0
  in_string <- FALSE
  escape <- FALSE
  end_idx <- NA_integer_
  
  for (i in seq_along(chars)) {
    ch <- chars[i]
    
    if (in_string) {
      if (escape) {
        escape <- FALSE
      } else if (ch == "\\") {
        escape <- TRUE
      } else if (ch == '"') {
        in_string <- FALSE
      }
    } else {
      if (ch == '"') {
        in_string <- TRUE
      } else if (ch == "{") {
        depth <- depth + 1
      } else if (ch == "}") {
        depth <- depth - 1
        if (depth == 0) {
          end_idx <- i
          break
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (is.na(end_idx)) {
    stop("Could not find the end of JSON object in Tomtom HTML.")
  }
  
  json_txt <- paste0(chars[1:end_idx], collapse = "")
  jsonlite::fromJSON(json_txt, simplifyVector = FALSE)
}

parse_tomtom_html <- function(html_file) {
  
  data <- extract_json_var_from_html(html_file, "data")
  
  queries <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(data$queries), function(i) {
    q <- data$queries[[i]]
    tibble(
      query_idx = i - 1,
      Query_ID = as.character(q$id),
      Query_alt = as.character(q$alt),
      Query_len = as.integer(q$len),
      Query_nsites = as.integer(q$nsites),
      Query_MEME_evalue = to_num(q$evalue)
    )
  })
  
  targets <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(data$targets), function(i) {
    t <- data$targets[[i]]
    tibble(
      target_idx = i - 1,
      Target_ID = as.character(t$id),
      Target_alt = ifelse(is.null(t$alt), NA_character_, as.character(t$alt)),
      Target_len = as.integer(t$len),
      Target_nsites = as.integer(t$nsites),
      Target_evalue = to_num(t$evalue),
      Target_url = ifelse(is.null(t$url), NA_character_, as.character(t$url))
    )
  })
  
  matches <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(data$all_matches), function(i) {
    one <- data$all_matches[[i]]
    qidx <- one$idx
    
    if (length(one$matches) == 0) return(tibble())
    
    purrr::map_dfr(one$matches, function(m) {
      tibble(
        query_idx = qidx,
        target_idx = m$idx,
        rc = ifelse(is.null(m$rc), NA, m$rc),
        offset = ifelse(is.null(m$off), NA_integer_, m$off),
        pvalue = to_num(m$pv),
        evalue = to_num(m$ev),
        qvalue = to_num(m$qv)
      )
    })
  })
  
  matches %>%
    left_join(queries, by = "query_idx") %>%
    left_join(targets, by = "target_idx")
}

if (file.exists(tomtom_tsv_file)) {
  
  tomtom_raw <- read_tsv(
    tomtom_tsv_file,
    comment = "#",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  colnames(tomtom_raw) <- make.names(colnames(tomtom_raw))
  
  tomtom_matches <- tomtom_raw %>%
    transmute(
      Query_ID = as.character(Query_ID),
      Query_alt = if ("Query_alt_ID" %in% colnames(.)) as.character(Query_alt_ID) else as.character(Query_ID),
      Target_ID = as.character(Target_ID),
      Target_alt = if ("Target_alt_ID" %in% colnames(.)) as.character(Target_alt_ID) else NA_character_,
      pvalue = if ("p.value" %in% colnames(.)) to_num(p.value) else NA_real_,
      evalue = if ("E.value" %in% colnames(.)) to_num(E.value) else NA_real_,
      qvalue = if ("q.value" %in% colnames(.)) to_num(q.value) else NA_real_
    )
  
} else if (file.exists(tomtom_html_file)) {
  
  tomtom_matches <- parse_tomtom_html(tomtom_html_file)
  
} else {
  stop("Cannot find Tomtom file: ", tomtom_html_file, " or ", tomtom_tsv_file)
}

tomtom_matches <- tomtom_matches %>%
  mutate(
    Query_ID = as.character(Query_ID),
    Query_alt = as.character(Query_alt),
    Query_MEME = str_extract(paste(Query_ID, Query_alt), "MEME-[0-9]+"),
    
    Target_ID = as.character(Target_ID),
    Target_alt = as.character(Target_alt),
    
    Target_family_raw = str_extract(Target_ID, "^[^_]+"),
    Target_family = normalize_tf_family(Target_family_raw),
    
    Target_TF_symbol = case_when(
      !is.na(Target_alt) & Target_alt != "" ~ Target_alt,
      str_detect(Target_ID, "tnt\\.") ~ str_match(Target_ID, "tnt\\.([^_]+)")[, 2],
      TRUE ~ Target_ID
    ),
    
    Target_AGI = str_extract(Target_alt, "AT[1-5CM]G[0-9]+"),
    
    pvalue_Tomtom = to_num(pvalue),
    evalue_Tomtom = to_num(evalue),
    qvalue_Tomtom = to_num(qvalue),
    
    Tomtom_confidence = case_when(
      !is.na(qvalue_Tomtom) & qvalue_Tomtom <= 0.05 ~ "high_q<=0.05",
      !is.na(qvalue_Tomtom) & qvalue_Tomtom <= 0.10 ~ "moderate_q<=0.10",
      !is.na(qvalue_Tomtom) & qvalue_Tomtom <= 0.20 ~ "low_q<=0.20",
      TRUE ~ "top_hit_only"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Query_alt, qvalue_Tomtom, evalue_Tomtom, pvalue_Tomtom)

tomtom_keep <- tomtom_matches %>%
  group_by(Query_alt) %>%
  arrange(qvalue_Tomtom, evalue_Tomtom, pvalue_Tomtom, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(rank_within_motif = row_number()) %>%
  filter(qvalue_Tomtom <= tomtom_q_cutoff | rank_within_motif <= top_tomtom_hits_per_motif) %>%
  ungroup()

tomtom_alias <- tomtom_keep %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Query_ID,
    Query_alt,
    Query_MEME,
    Target_ID,
    Target_alt,
    Target_family_raw,
    Target_family,
    Target_TF_symbol,
    Target_AGI,
    pvalue_Tomtom,
    evalue_Tomtom,
    qvalue_Tomtom,
    Tomtom_confidence,
    rank_within_motif
  ) %>%
  make_motif_alias_long(
    motif_cols = c("Query_ID", "Query_alt", "Query_MEME"),
    keep_cols = c(
      "Target_ID", "Target_alt", "Target_family_raw", "Target_family",
      "Target_TF_symbol", "Target_AGI",
      "pvalue_Tomtom", "evalue_Tomtom", "qvalue_Tomtom",
      "Tomtom_confidence", "rank_within_motif"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-row_id_tmp) %>%
  distinct()

write_tsv(tomtom_matches, file.path(outdir, "Tomtom_all_matches_parsed.tsv"))
write_tsv(tomtom_keep, file.path(outdir, "Tomtom_kept_matches_for_TF_mapping.tsv"))
write_tsv(tomtom_alias, file.path(outdir, "Tomtom_motif_alias_table.tsv"))

cat("\n===== Tomtom check =====\n")
cat("All Tomtom matches:", nrow(tomtom_matches), "\n")
cat("Kept Tomtom matches:", nrow(tomtom_keep), "\n")
cat("Tomtom motif aliases:", n_distinct(tomtom_alias$Motif), "\n")
print(sort(unique(tomtom_alias$Target_family)))

############################################################
## 5. Read FIMO results and build motif alias table
############################################################

read_fimo_fixed <- function(file) {
  
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop("Cannot find FIMO file: ", file)
  }
  
  df <- read_tsv(
    file,
    comment = "#",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  colnames(df) <- make.names(colnames(df))
  
  if (!all(c("motif_id", "sequence_name", "start", "stop", "strand", "score", "p.value") %in% colnames(df))) {
    stop("FIMO file does not have expected columns: ", file)
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      motif_id = as.character(motif_id),
      motif_alt_id = if ("motif_alt_id" %in% colnames(.)) as.character(motif_alt_id) else NA_character_,
      Motif_MEME = str_extract(paste(motif_id, motif_alt_id), "MEME-[0-9]+"),
      
      sequence_name_raw = as.character(sequence_name),
      Gene = clean_gene_id(sequence_name_raw),
      
      start = as.integer(start),
      stop = as.integer(stop),
      pvalue_FIMO = to_num(p.value),
      qvalue_FIMO = if ("q.value" %in% colnames(.)) to_num(q.value) else NA_real_,
      score_FIMO = to_num(score),
      matched_sequence = if ("matched_sequence" %in% colnames(.)) as.character(matched_sequence) else NA_character_
    ) %>%
    filter(
      pvalue_FIMO <= fimo_p_cutoff |
        (!is.na(qvalue_FIMO) & qvalue_FIMO <= fimo_q_cutoff)
    )
}

fimo_nlr <- read_fimo_fixed(fimo_nlr_file)
fimo_all <- read_fimo_fixed(fimo_all_file)

fimo_nlr_alias <- fimo_nlr %>%
  dplyr::select(
    motif_id,

############################################################
## 7. Motif enrichment in NLR promoters versus all promoters
############################################################

nlr_background_ids <- unique(fimo_nlr_alias$NLR_gene)
all_background_ids <- unique(fimo_all_alias$Gene)

motif_enrichment <- unique(c(fimo_nlr_alias$Motif, fimo_all_alias$Motif)) %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(function(m) {
    
    nlr_with <- fimo_nlr_alias %>%
      filter(Motif == m) %>%
      pull(NLR_gene) %>%
      unique()
    
    all_with <- fimo_all_alias %>%
      filter(Motif == m) %>%
      pull(Gene) %>%
      unique()
    
    bg_non_nlr <- setdiff(all_background_ids, nlr_background_ids)
    
    nlr_a <- sum(nlr_background_ids %in% nlr_with)
    nlr_b <- length(nlr_background_ids) - nlr_a
    
    bg_a <- sum(bg_non_nlr %in% all_with)
    bg_b <- length(bg_non_nlr) - bg_a
    
    mat <- matrix(
      c(nlr_a, nlr_b, bg_a, bg_b),
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
    
    ft <- fisher.test(mat)
    
    tibble(
      Motif = m,
      NLR_with_motif = nlr_a,
      NLR_without_motif = nlr_b,
      Background_with_motif = bg_a,
      Background_without_motif = bg_b,
      OddsRatio = unname(ft$estimate),
      pvalue = ft$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
    Motif_enriched_in_NLR = FDR < 0.05 & OddsRatio > 1
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR, desc(OddsRatio))

write_tsv(
  motif_enrichment,
  file.path(outdir, "Motif_enrichment_DE_NLR_vs_background_promoters.tsv")
)

## 13. Compute TF-NLR expression correlations
############################################################

gene_sd <- sapply(datExpr, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))

cat("NLRs:", n_distinct(candidate_pairs_valid$NLR_gene), "\n")

if (nrow(candidate_pairs_valid) == 0) {
  stop("No valid TF-NLR pairs after variance filtering.")
}

compute_cor_for_pairs_fixed <- function(pair_df, datExpr) {
  
  pair_df <- pair_df %>%
    distinct(TF_gene, NLR_gene)
  
  tf_genes <- intersect(unique(pair_df$TF_gene), colnames(datExpr))
  nlr_genes <- intersect(unique(pair_df$NLR_gene), colnames(datExpr))
  
  if (length(tf_genes) == 0 || length(nlr_genes) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        TF_gene = character(),
        NLR_gene = character(),
        TF_NLR_cor = numeric(),
        TF_NLR_abs_cor = numeric(),
        TF_NLR_cor_pvalue = numeric()
      )
    )
  }
  
  tf_mat <- as.matrix(datExpr[, tf_genes, drop = FALSE])
  nlr_mat <- as.matrix(datExpr[, nlr_genes, drop = FALSE])
  
  cor_mat <- cor(
    tf_mat,
    nlr_mat,
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
    method = "pearson"
  )
  
  p_mat <- WGCNA::corPvalueStudent(
    cor_mat,
    nSamples = nrow(datExpr)
  )
  
  cor_long <- expand.grid(
    TF_gene = rownames(cor_mat),
    NLR_gene = colnames(cor_mat),
    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      TF_NLR_cor = as.numeric(as.vector(cor_mat)),
      TF_NLR_abs_cor = abs(TF_NLR_cor),
      TF_NLR_cor_pvalue = as.numeric(as.vector(p_mat))
    )
  
  pair_df %>%
    left_join(cor_long, by = c("TF_gene", "NLR_gene")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(TF_NLR_cor))
}

pair_cor <- compute_cor_for_pairs_fixed(
  candidate_pairs_valid,
  datExpr
) %>%
  mutate(
    TF_NLR_cor_FDR = p.adjust(TF_NLR_cor_pvalue, method = "BH"),
    CorDirection = case_when(
      TF_NLR_cor > 0 ~ "positive",
      TF_NLR_cor < 0 ~ "negative",
      TRUE ~ "zero"
    )
  )

cat("\n===== TF-NLR correlation result =====\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(pair_cor), "\n")
cat("TFs:", n_distinct(pair_cor$TF_gene), "\n")
cat("NLRs:", n_distinct(pair_cor$NLR_gene), "\n")

    arrange(desc(TF_NLR_abs_cor)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20)
)

)

}

tf_de_info <- tf_anno %>%
  dplyr::select(
    TF_gene,
    TF_family,
    TF_family_raw,
    TF_name,
    any_of(c("Arabidopsis_homolog", "Arabidopsis_hit", "Ath_pident", "Ath_evalue", "Ath_bitscore"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    res_lrt_all %>%
      rename(
        TF_baseMean = baseMean,
        TF_stat = stat,
        TF_pvalue = pvalue,
        TF_padj = padj
      ),
    by = c("TF_gene" = "Gene")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TF_DE_LRT = !is.na(TF_padj) & TF_padj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    gene_module_df_clean %>%
      rename(TF_module = Module),
    by = c("TF_gene" = "Gene")
  )

nlr_info <- nlr_master %>%
  dplyr::select(
    any_of(c(
      "Gene", "Type", "baseMean", "stat", "pvalue", "padj", "DE_LRT",
      "Cluster", "max_abs_log2FC", "log2FC_at_max",
      "main_response_time", "direction_at_max", "response_strength",
      "Wald_sig_timepoints"
    ))
  ) %>%
  rename(
    NLR_gene = Gene,
    NLR_Type = Type,
    NLR_baseMean = baseMean,
    NLR_stat = stat,
    NLR_pvalue = pvalue,
    NLR_padj = padj,
    NLR_DE_LRT = DE_LRT
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NLR_DE_LRT = as_logical_safe(NLR_DE_LRT)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    gene_module_df_clean %>%
      rename(NLR_module = Module),
    by = c("NLR_gene" = "Gene")
  )

candidate_edges <- candidate_pairs_valid %>%
  left_join(pair_cor, by = c("TF_gene", "NLR_gene")) %>%
  left_join(tf_de_info, by = "TF_gene") %>%
  left_join(nlr_info, by = "NLR_gene") %>%
  left_join(
    motif_enrichment %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Motif,
        Motif_OddsRatio = OddsRatio,
        Motif_enrichment_pvalue = pvalue,
        Motif_enrichment_FDR = FDR,
        Motif_enriched_in_NLR
      ),
    by = "Motif"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SameModule = !is.na(TF_module) & !is.na(NLR_module) & TF_module == NLR_module,
    
    Tomtom_pass_q = !is.na(qvalue_Tomtom) & qvalue_Tomtom <= tomtom_q_cutoff,
    
    FIMO_pass = FIMO_best_pvalue <= fimo_p_cutoff |
      (!is.na(FIMO_best_qvalue) & FIMO_best_qvalue <= fimo_q_cutoff),
    
    Cor_pass = !is.na(TF_NLR_abs_cor) &
      TF_NLR_abs_cor >= min_abs_cor &
      TF_NLR_cor_pvalue <= max_cor_pvalue,
    
    EvidenceScore =
      1 +
      if_else(Tomtom_pass_q, 1, 0) +
      if_else(Motif_enriched_in_NLR, 1, 0) +
      if_else(Cor_pass, 1, 0) +
      if_else(TF_DE_LRT, 1, 0) +
      if_else(SameModule, 1, 0),
    
    EvidenceClass = case_when(
      EvidenceScore >= 5 ~ "High",
      EvidenceScore >= 3 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "Low"
    ),
    
    EdgeDirection = case_when(
      TF_NLR_cor > 0 ~ "positive_candidate_activation",
      TF_NLR_cor < 0 ~ "negative_candidate_repression",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  )

candidate_edges_filtered <- candidate_edges %>%
  filter(Cor_pass) %>%
  { if (require_TF_DE) filter(., TF_DE_LRT) else . } %>%
  { if (require_same_module) filter(., SameModule) else . } %>%
  arrange(
    desc(EvidenceScore),
    desc(TF_NLR_abs_cor),
    TF_NLR_cor_pvalue,
    qvalue_Tomtom,
    FIMO_best_pvalue
  )

write_tsv(
  candidate_edges,
  file.path(outdir, "Candidate_TF_NLR_edges_all_before_correlation_filter.tsv")
)

write_tsv(
  candidate_edges_filtered,
  file.path(outdir, "Candidate_TF_NLR_edges.tsv")
)

cat("NLRs:", n_distinct(candidate_edges_filtered$NLR_gene), "\n")

}

############################################################
## 16. Cytoscape node table
############################################################

if (nrow(cyto_edges) > 0) {
  
  tf_nodes <- cyto_edges %>%
    distinct(Gene = Source) %>%
    left_join(
      tf_de_info,
      by = c("Gene" = "TF_gene")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      NodeType = "TF",
      NodeClass = paste0("TF_", TF_family),
      Type = TF_family,
      Module = TF_module,
      DE_LRT = TF_DE_LRT,
      padj = TF_padj
    )
  
  nlr_nodes <- cyto_edges %>%
    distinct(Gene = Target) %>%
    left_join(
      nlr_info,
      by = c("Gene" = "NLR_gene")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      NodeType = "NLR",
      NodeClass = paste0("NLR_", NLR_Type),
      Type = NLR_Type,
      Module = NLR_module,
      DE_LRT = NLR_DE_LRT,
      padj = NLR_padj
    )
  
  nodes <- bind_rows(
    tf_nodes %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Gene, NodeType, NodeClass, Type, Module, DE_LRT, padj,
        TF_family, TF_family_raw, TF_name,
        any_of(c("Arabidopsis_homolog", "Arabidopsis_hit", "Ath_pident", "Ath_evalue", "Ath_bitscore")),
        TF_baseMean, TF_stat, TF_pvalue, TF_padj
      ),
    nlr_nodes %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Gene, NodeType, NodeClass, Type, Module, DE_LRT, padj,
        NLR_Type, NLR_baseMean, NLR_stat, NLR_pvalue, NLR_padj,
        any_of(c(
          "Cluster", "max_abs_log2FC", "log2FC_at_max",
          "main_response_time", "direction_at_max",
          "response_strength", "Wald_sig_timepoints"
        ))
      )
  ) %>%
    distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  degree_out <- cyto_edges %>%
    count(Source, name = "OutDegree") %>%
    rename(Gene = Source)
  
  degree_in <- cyto_edges %>%
    count(Target, name = "InDegree") %>%
    rename(Gene = Target)
  
  weighted_degree <- bind_rows(
    cyto_edges %>% transmute(Gene = Source, weight = abs_cor),
    cyto_edges %>% transmute(Gene = Target, weight = abs_cor)
  ) %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    summarise(
      WeightedDegree = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
      MeanAbsCor = mean(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
      MaxAbsCor = max(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  nodes <- nodes %>%
    left_join(degree_out, by = "Gene") %>%
    left_join(degree_in, by = "Gene") %>%
    left_join(weighted_degree, by = "Gene") %>%
    mutate(
      OutDegree = replace_na(OutDegree, 0L),
      InDegree = replace_na(InDegree, 0L),
      Degree = OutDegree + InDegree,
      WeightedDegree = replace_na(WeightedDegree, 0),
      MeanAbsCor = replace_na(MeanAbsCor, 0),
      MaxAbsCor = replace_na(MaxAbsCor, 0)
    ) %>%
    arrange(NodeType, desc(Degree), Gene)
  
} else {
  
  nodes <- tibble(
    Gene = character(),
    NodeType = character(),
    NodeClass = character(),
    Type = character(),
    Module = character(),
    DE_LRT = logical(),
    padj = numeric(),
    OutDegree = integer(),
    InDegree = integer(),
    Degree = integer(),
    WeightedDegree = numeric()
  )
}

write_tsv(
  nodes,
  file.path(outdir, "Cytoscape_TF_NLR_nodes.tsv")
)

write_tsv(
  nodes,
  file.path(outdir, "Candidate_TF_NLR_nodes.tsv")
)

############################################################
## 17. Hub ranking tables
############################################################

tf_hub_ranking <- nodes %>%
  filter(NodeType == "TF") %>%
  arrange(desc(OutDegree), desc(WeightedDegree), desc(MaxAbsCor)) %>%
  mutate(TF_HubRank = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    TF_HubRank,
    Gene,
    TF_name,
    TF_family,
    Module,
    DE_LRT,
    padj,
    OutDegree,
    WeightedDegree,
    MeanAbsCor,
    MaxAbsCor,
    everything()
  )

nlr_regulatory_target_ranking <- nodes %>%
  filter(NodeType == "NLR") %>%
  arrange(desc(InDegree), desc(WeightedDegree), desc(MaxAbsCor)) %>%
  mutate(NLR_TargetRank = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    NLR_TargetRank,
    Gene,
    Type,
    Module,
    DE_LRT,
    padj,
    InDegree,
    WeightedDegree,
    MeanAbsCor,
    MaxAbsCor,
    any_of(c("Cluster", "max_abs_log2FC", "main_response_time", "direction_at_max")),
    everything()
  )

write_tsv(
  tf_hub_ranking,
  file.path(outdir, "Candidate_TF_hub_ranking.tsv")
)

write_tsv(
  nlr_regulatory_target_ranking,
  file.path(outdir, "Candidate_NLR_regulatory_target_ranking.tsv")
)

############################################################
## 18. Summary tables
############################################################

if (nrow(cyto_edges) > 0) {
  
  edge_summary_by_family <- cyto_edges %>%
    group_by(TF_family) %>%
    summarise(
      TF_count = n_distinct(Source),
      NLR_target_count = n_distinct(Target),
      Edge_count = n(),
      High_edges = sum(EvidenceClass == "High"),
      Medium_edges = sum(EvidenceClass == "Medium"),
      Low_edges = sum(EvidenceClass == "Low"),
      Mean_abs_cor = mean(abs_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
      SameModule_edges = sum(SameModule, na.rm = TRUE),
      TF_DE_edges = sum(TF_DE_LRT, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Edge_count), desc(High_edges), desc(Mean_abs_cor))
  
  edge_summary_by_motif <- cyto_edges %>%
    group_by(Motif) %>%
    summarise(
      TF_family_count = n_distinct(TF_family),
      TF_count = n_distinct(Source),
      NLR_target_count = n_distinct(Target),
      Edge_count = n(),
      Mean_abs_cor = mean(abs_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
      Motif_OddsRatio = first(Motif_OddsRatio),
      Motif_enrichment_FDR = first(Motif_enrichment_FDR),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Edge_count), Motif_enrichment_FDR)
  
} else {
  
  edge_summary_by_family <- tibble()
  edge_summary_by_motif <- tibble()
}

write_tsv(
  edge_summary_by_family,
  file.path(outdir, "TF_NLR_edge_summary_by_TF_family.tsv")
)

write_tsv(
  edge_summary_by_motif,
  file.path(outdir, "TF_NLR_edge_summary_by_motif.tsv")
)

############################################################
## 19. Figures
############################################################

## Fig1 Tomtom motif-family heatmap
tomtom_family_heatmap <- tomtom_keep %>%
  group_by(Query_alt, Target_family) %>%
  summarise(
    best_qvalue = suppressWarnings(min(qvalue_Tomtom, na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_matches = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    best_qvalue = ifelse(is.infinite(best_qvalue), NA_real_, best_qvalue),
    neglog10_q = -log10(pmax(best_qvalue, .Machine$double.xmin))
  )

if (nrow(tomtom_family_heatmap) > 0) {
  
  p1 <- ggplot(
    tomtom_family_heatmap,
    aes(x = Query_alt, y = Target_family, fill = neglog10_q)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_matches), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#B2182B", na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(
      title = "Tomtom motif-to-TF-family similarity",
      x = "MEME motif",
      y = "Inferred TF family",
      fill = "-log10(best q)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  print(p1)
  save_plot(p1, "Fig1_Tomtom_motif_TF_family_heatmap", width = 8.5, height = 5.5)
}

## Fig2 motif enrichment
if (nrow(motif_enrichment) > 0) {
  
  p2 <- motif_enrichment %>%
    mutate(
      Motif = factor(Motif, levels = rev(Motif)),
      FDR_plot = pmax(FDR, .Machine$double.xmin)
    ) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(x = OddsRatio, y = Motif, size = NLR_with_motif, color = -log10(FDR_plot))
    ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    labs(
      title = "Motif occurrence enrichment in DE NLR promoters",
      x = "Odds ratio, DE NLR promoters vs background",
      y = "MEME motif",
      size = "NLR promoters with motif",
      color = "-log10(FDR)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  print(p2)
  save_plot(p2, "Fig2_motif_enrichment_in_DE_NLR_promoters", width = 8, height = 5.5)
}

## Fig3 TF family edge counts
if (nrow(edge_summary_by_family) > 0) {
  
  p3 <- edge_summary_by_family %>%
    mutate(TF_family = factor(TF_family, levels = rev(TF_family))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Edge_count, y = TF_family)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Edge_count), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, max(edge_summary_by_family$Edge_count, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Candidate TF-NLR regulatory edges by TF family",
      x = "Candidate TF-NLR edge count",
      y = "TF family"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  print(p3)
  save_plot(p3, "Fig3_TF_NLR_edge_counts_by_TF_family", width = 7.5, height = 5.5)
}

## Fig4 top TF hubs
if (nrow(tf_hub_ranking) > 0) {
  
  top_tf_n <- min(25, nrow(tf_hub_ranking))
  
  p4 <- tf_hub_ranking %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_tf_n) %>%
    mutate(
      Label = ifelse(!is.na(TF_name) & TF_name != "", TF_name, Gene),
      Label = factor(Label, levels = rev(Label))
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = OutDegree, y = Label, fill = TF_family)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Top ", top_tf_n, " candidate TF hubs"),
      x = "Out-degree to NLR targets",
      y = "Candidate TF",
      fill = "TF family"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  print(p4)
  save_plot(p4, "Fig4_top_candidate_TF_hubs", width = 8, height = 7)
}

## Fig5 evidence class composition
if (nrow(cyto_edges) > 0) {
  
  p5 <- cyto_edges %>%
    count(EvidenceClass, name = "Edge_count") %>%
    mutate(EvidenceClass = factor(EvidenceClass, levels = c("High", "Medium", "Low"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = EvidenceClass, y = Edge_count, fill = EvidenceClass)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Edge_count), vjust = -0.4, size = 4) +
    labs(
      title = "Evidence classes of candidate TF-NLR regulatory edges",
      x = "Evidence class",
      y = "Edge count"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  print(p5)
  save_plot(p5, "Fig5_TF_NLR_edge_evidence_classes", width = 6, height = 5)
}

## Fig6 correlation distribution
if (nrow(cyto_edges) > 0) {
  
  p6 <- ggplot(
    cyto_edges,
    aes(x = Correlation, fill = Direction)
  ) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(positive = "#B2182B", negative = "#2166AC", zero = "grey70")) +
    labs(
      title = "Expression correlation of candidate TF-NLR edges",
      x = "TF-NLR expression correlation",
      y = "Edge count",
      fill = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  print(p6)
  save_plot(p6, "Fig6_TF_NLR_correlation_distribution", width = 7, height = 5)
}

############################################################
## 20. Export text summary
############################################################

summary_file <- file.path(outdir, "TF_NLR_candidate_regulatory_network_summary.txt")

sink(summary_file)

cat("Candidate TF-NLR regulatory network summary\n")
cat("==========================================\n\n")

cat("1. Parameters\n")
cat("Tomtom q cutoff:", tomtom_q_cutoff, "\n")
cat("Top Tomtom hits per motif:", top_tomtom_hits_per_motif, "\n")
cat("FIMO p cutoff:", fimo_p_cutoff, "\n")
cat("FIMO q cutoff:", fimo_q_cutoff, "\n")
cat("Minimum absolute TF-NLR correlation:", min_abs_cor, "\n")
cat("Maximum correlation p-value:", max_cor_pvalue, "\n")
cat("Require TF DE:", require_TF_DE, "\n")
cat("Require same WGCNA module:", require_same_module, "\n\n")

cat("2. Input diagnostics\n")
cat("Total TF genes:", nrow(tf_anno), "\n")
cat("TF genes in datExpr:", sum(tf_anno$TF_gene %in% colnames(datExpr)), "\n")
cat("Tomtom kept matches:", nrow(tomtom_keep), "\n")
cat("FIMO NLR motif hits:", nrow(fimo_nlr_alias), "\n")
cat("Motif overlaps between Tomtom and FIMO:", length(motif_overlap), "\n")
cat("Candidate pairs before expression filtering:", nrow(candidate_pairs_before_expr), "\n")
cat("Candidate pairs after expression filtering:", nrow(candidate_pairs_pre), "\n")
cat("Candidate pairs after variance filtering:", nrow(candidate_pairs_valid), "\n")
cat("Candidate TF-NLR edges after correlation filtering:", nrow(candidate_edges_filtered), "\n\n")

cat("3. Tomtom motif-to-TF-family summary\n")
print(
  tomtom_keep %>%
    count(Query_alt, Target_family, name = "n_matches") %>%
    arrange(Query_alt, desc(n_matches))
)
cat("\n")

cat("4. Motif enrichment summary\n")
print(motif_enrichment)
cat("\n")

cat("5. Candidate edge summary by TF family\n")
print(edge_summary_by_family)
cat("\n")

cat("6. Candidate edge summary by motif\n")
print(edge_summary_by_motif)
cat("\n")

cat("7. Top candidate TF hubs\n")
print(
  tf_hub_ranking %>%
    dplyr::select(
      any_of(c(
        "TF_HubRank", "Gene", "TF_name", "TF_family", "Module",
        "DE_LRT", "padj", "OutDegree", "WeightedDegree", "MeanAbsCor", "MaxAbsCor"
      ))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 30)
)
cat("\n")

cat("8. Top candidate NLR regulatory targets\n")
print(
  nlr_regulatory_target_ranking %>%
    dplyr::select(
      any_of(c(
        "NLR_TargetRank", "Gene", "Type", "Module", "DE_LRT", "padj",
        "InDegree", "WeightedDegree", "max_abs_log2FC",
        "main_response_time", "direction_at_max"
      ))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 30)
)
cat("\n")

cat("9. Interpretation note\n")
cat(
  "This network should be interpreted as a candidate TF-NLR regulatory network. ",
  "A TF-NLR edge is supported by promoter motif occurrence, Tomtom-inferred TF family similarity, ",
  "TF-NLR expression correlation, and optional WGCNA module consistency. ",
  "These edges do not prove direct binding or causal regulation and should be prioritized for future validation.\n",
  sep = ""
)

sink()

############################################################
## 21. Save RDS
############################################################

saveRDS(
  list(
    tf_anno = tf_anno,
    tomtom_matches = tomtom_matches,
    tomtom_keep = tomtom_keep,
    tomtom_alias = tomtom_alias,
    fimo_nlr = fimo_nlr,
    fimo_all = fimo_all,
    fimo_nlr_alias = fimo_nlr_alias,
    nlr_motif_hits = nlr_motif_hits,
    motif_enrichment = motif_enrichment,
    motif_tf_candidates = motif_tf_candidates,
    candidate_pairs_before_expr = candidate_pairs_before_expr,
    candidate_pairs_pre = candidate_pairs_pre,
    candidate_pairs_valid = candidate_pairs_valid,
    pair_cor = pair_cor,
    candidate_edges_all = candidate_edges,
    candidate_edges_filtered = candidate_edges_filtered,
    cyto_edges = cyto_edges,
    nodes = nodes,
    tf_hub_ranking = tf_hub_ranking,
    nlr_regulatory_target_ranking = nlr_regulatory_target_ranking,
    edge_summary_by_family = edge_summary_by_family,
    edge_summary_by_motif = edge_summary_by_motif,
    parameters = list(
      tomtom_q_cutoff = tomtom_q_cutoff,
      top_tomtom_hits_per_motif = top_tomtom_hits_per_motif,
      fimo_p_cutoff = fimo_p_cutoff,
      fimo_q_cutoff = fimo_q_cutoff,
      min_abs_cor = min_abs_cor,
      max_cor_pvalue = max_cor_pvalue,
      require_TF_DE = require_TF_DE,
      require_same_module = require_same_module
    )
  ),
  file.path(outdir, "TF_NLR_candidate_regulatory_network_results.rds")
)

############################################################
## 22. Final message
############################################################

cat("\nDone. Results saved in:\n")
cat(outdir, "\n\n")


cat("Key diagnostics:\n")
cat("TF genes:", nrow(tf_anno), "\n")
cat("TF genes in expression:", sum(tf_anno$TF_gene %in% colnames(datExpr)), "\n")
cat("Motif overlaps between Tomtom and FIMO:", length(motif_overlap), "\n")
cat("Candidate pairs before expression filtering:", nrow(candidate_pairs_before_expr), "\n")
cat("Candidate pairs after expression filtering:", nrow(candidate_pairs_pre), "\n")
cat("Candidate edges after correlation filtering:", nrow(candidate_edges_filtered), "\n")
```
